tools.name: create-payment-button
tools.description:
Create a Kushki payment button using webcheckout

This tool creates a payment button using Kushki's webcheckout API, which provides a secure and customizable payment experience for your customers.

## Environment:
This tool uses the test environment (https://api-uat.kushkipagos.com).

## Response:
The tool returns an object with:
- `id`: The unique identifier for the created payment button (webcheckoutId)
- `url`: The URL that can be used to access the payment button (webcheckoutUrl)

redirect_url.description: URL where the customer will be redirected after completing or canceling the payment process

description.description: Detailed description of the product that will be displayed to the customer

name.description: Name of the product that will be displayed to the customer

quantity.description: Number of units of the product (must be greater than 0)

unitPrice.description: Price per unit of the product in the specified currency (must be non-negative)

products.description: Array of products to be purchased, each with description, name, quantity, and unitPrice

subtotalIva0.description: Subtotal amount for items with 0% VAT (must be non-negative)

currency.description: Currency code for the transaction (COP: Colombian Peso, CLP: Chilean Peso, UF: Chilean Unidad de Fomento, PEN: Peruvian Sol, MXN: Mexican Peso, USD: US Dollar)

iva.description: VAT (Value Added Tax) amount in the specified currency (must be non-negative)

subtotalIva.description: Subtotal amount for items with VAT in the specified currency (must be non-negative)

amount.description: Payment amount details including subtotals, VAT, and currency

paymentMethod.description: Array of allowed payment methods: cash (cash payments), transfer (bank transfers), card-async (asynchronous card payments), credit-card (credit/debit card payments), card-dynamic (dynamic card payments)

transactionType.description: Transaction type - use PRE_AUTH for authorization and capture flow, omit for direct charge

payment_config.description: Payment configuration including amount details, allowed payment methods, and optional transaction type

email.description: Customer's email address for sending payment confirmation and receipts

name.description: Customer's full name that will appear on the payment receipt

contact_detail.description: Customer contact information including email and name

additional_information.description: Any additional data you want to include in the payment process and receive in webhooks (e.g., order ID, customer ID, etc.)

tools.name: void-transaction
tools.description:
Void or refund a Kushki transaction

This tool allows you to void or refund a transaction that was previously processed through Kushki.
The transaction is identified by its ticket number, which is provided when a charge is successful.

## Environment:
This tool uses the test environment (https://api-uat.kushkipagos.com).

## Response:
The tool returns an object with transaction details including:
- Transaction status
- Transaction type (VOID or REFUND)
- Approval code
- Response text
- And other transaction details

## Notes:
- When the date of the transaction to void surpasses the timeframe for automatic voiding, it becomes a refund
- Partial voids are only available in Chile, Colombia, Mexico and Peru
- For full voids, the amount object is not required

private_merchant_id.description: Your Kushki Private Merchant ID for authentication with the Kushki API (required if not provided when starting the server)

ticket_number.description: The ticket number of the transaction to void or refund

full_response.description: Set to "v2" to get a more detailed response

subtotalIva.description: Subtotal amount for items with VAT

subtotalIva0.description: Subtotal amount for items with 0% VAT

amount.description: For partial voids/refunds (only available in Chile, Colombia, Mexico and Peru)

metadata.description: Any additional data you want to include in the void/refund process and receive in webhooks (e.g., order ID, customer ID, etc.)

events.description: Array of events to trigger webhook notifications

headers.description: Optional headers to include in webhook requests

urls.description: Array of URLs to send webhook notifications to

external_reference_id.description: Your own reference ID for the transaction (5-64 characters, only - and _ special characters allowed)

tools.name: get-subscription-info
tools.description:
Get information about a Kushki recurring subscription

This tool retrieves detailed information about a specific recurring subscription in Kushki,
identified by its subscription ID.

## Environment:
This tool uses the test environment (https://api-uat.kushkipagos.com).

## Response:
The tool returns an object with detailed subscription information including:
- Amount details (subtotalIva0, subtotalIva, iva, ice, currency)
- Card information (bin, cardHolderName, cardType, lastFourDigits, maskedCardNumber)
- Contact details (firstName, lastName, email)
- Subscription details (created, merchantId, paymentBrand, periodicity, planName, startDate)
- Metadata (if available)

## Notes:
- This functionality is available for both Acquirer and Aggregator models
- The service is available in Ecuador, Chile, Colombia, México, and Perú

private_merchant_id.description: Your Kushki Private Merchant ID for authentication with the Kushki API (required if not provided when starting the server)

subscription_id.description: The ID of the subscription to retrieve information for

tools.name: list-transactions
tools.description:
List Kushki transactions within a specified date range

This tool retrieves a list of transactions processed through Kushki within the specified date range.

## Environment:
This tool uses the test environment (https://api-uat.kushkipagos.com).

## Response:
The tool returns an object with:
- `total`: Total number of transactions found
- `data`: Array of transaction objects with detailed information

## Notes:
- The date range should not exceed 30 days
- Dates must be in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS)
- The maximum number of transactions returned is limited by the Kushki API

private_merchant_id.description: Your Kushki Private Merchant ID for authentication with the Kushki API (required if not provided when starting the server)

from.description: Start date of search in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS). Example: 2022-03-10T13:39:00

to.description: End date of search in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS). Example: 2022-03-10T23:00:00
